analysis: Documentation-only PR: docs/architecture/README.md (head text shown, 'Last updated: 2026-10-09') and docs/architecture/cache-aware-routing.md (date bump plus a new paragraph at the start of the 'Protocol v2 proof' section, patch hunk @@ -258,6 +258,15 @@).
